finalText:

`macroAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `returnService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `session.js`, `refund.js`, `teamService.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`, `variantAdmin.js`.

Next: flag that vendor file to whoever owns the `legacy-orm` upgrade, since `db.query` is slated for removal.
